en.p: Let $A$ be the area of the region enclosed by the curve $y=\dfrac{1}{4}x^{3}+\dfrac{1}{2}x$, the line $y=mx+2$, and the $y$-axis, and let $B$ be the area of the region enclosed by the curve $y=\dfrac{1}{4}x^{3}+\dfrac{1}{2}x$ and the two lines $y=mx+2$ and $x=2$. When $B-A=\dfrac{2}{3}$, what is the value of the constant $m$? (Given that $m<-1$.) [4 points]
